'''Hedrett Holovid''' was a [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] shop, that was located in [[Hedrett]], on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], and it operated during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was run by [[Gar Bettle]], a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]], and [[Nek Lawsirk]], a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], was one of his regular customers.
